title: Agentic object detection
reading: The slide illustrates agentic object detection with two side-by-side example outputs, each driven by a natural-language prompt rather than a fixed class label. The left example uses the prompt "Detect unripe strawberries in the picture" and the right uses "Detect airplanes with two engines". A LandingAI credit appears in the bottom right corner.

visuals.description: Photo of a strawberry plant with many green bounding boxes labelled 'unripe strawberries (1.00)' placed on green, unripe fruit while ripe red berries are left unboxed.
visuals.assertion: The system correctly localises only the unripe fruit, honouring the attribute constraint in the free-text prompt.

visuals.description: Photo of an airport apron with several parked airliners; green boxes labelled 'planes with 2 engin... (1.00)' surround twin-engine aircraft while the four-engine Lufthansa A380 is not boxed.
visuals.assertion: Detection can apply a compositional, counting-based property (two engines) that no standard detector class encodes.

concepts.name: Agentic object detection
concepts.why_it_matters: Enables detection from free-form language descriptions with attributes, instead of a fixed set of trained classes.
